# `state_stages`

Stages of state regulatory actions, one row per stage: NOIRA (notice of intended regulatory action), Proposed, Final, Fast-Track, Emergency and similar. A stage is the state counterpart of a regulations.gov document: it carries the comment period, the Virginia Register publication and the agency's documents. Virginia only so far, from the Virginia Regulatory Town Hall. In-progress stages are refetched at least weekly, and every stage whose comment forum is open or recently closed is refetched daily; older stages keep the values from their last fetch (`fetched_at`). Sorted by `jurisdiction`, then `stage_id` descending. Built by `build_va_townhall`.

- **Parquet file:** `state_stages.parquet`
- **Queryable via MCP `query_sql`:** Yes

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `jurisdiction` | `VARCHAR` | USPS code of the state (`VA`). |
| `stage_id` | `BIGINT` | Town Hall stage ID. Unique within `jurisdiction`; joins `state_comments.stage_id`. |
| `action_id` | `BIGINT` | Action the stage belongs to (joins `state_actions.action_id`). |
| `stage_type` | `VARCHAR` | Stage type as Town Hall labels it, e.g. `NOIRA`, `Proposed`, `Final`, `Fast-Track`, `Emergency/NOIRA`. |
| `status` | `VARCHAR` | Town Hall's status line for the stage, e.g. `Stage complete. This regulation became effective on 11/05/2026.` or `Comment period is underway and will end on 12/18/2026.` |
| `agency` | `VARCHAR` | Agency that owns the regulation. |
| `board` | `VARCHAR` | Board or other body that adopts the regulation. |
| `chapter_citation` | `VARCHAR` | Virginia Administrative Code chapter, normalized to `18VAC125-20` (see `state_actions.chapter_citation`). |
| `comment_start_date` | `VARCHAR` | Start of the public comment period (YYYY-MM-DD). Town Hall prints only the end date; under the Virginia Administrative Process Act the period opens on publication in the Virginia Register, so this is `register_date`. NULL when the stage has no comment period. |
| `comment_end_date` | `VARCHAR` | End of the public comment period (YYYY-MM-DD). NULL when the stage has no comment period (Final stages usually do not). |
| `comment_count` | `BIGINT` | Number of comments the stage page reported when fetched. Can trail `state_comments` for a stage that has not been refetched. |
| `register_volume` | `BIGINT` | Virginia Register of Regulations volume the stage was published in. |
| `register_issue` | `BIGINT` | Virginia Register issue number. |
| `register_date` | `VARCHAR` | Virginia Register publication date (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `effective_date` | `VARCHAR` | Date the regulation took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), on Final and Fast-Track stages that have one. |
| `documents_json` | `VARCHAR` | JSON array of the agency's documents for the stage (text, background document, economic impact analysis, review memos), each `{title, date, url}`. `url` is NULL for a listed document not yet submitted. |
| `url` | `VARCHAR` | Town Hall page for the stage. |
| `fetched_at` | `VARCHAR` | UTC time this row was last fetched (ISO 8601). |
